description: Run on each new model within days of its release (docs/specs/model-adaptation.md, AC-1). Cases that have shown a rule effect run with and without rules; for each other target failure, one saturated case runs without rules as a control, to show whether the failure comes back. Chosen from the results up to 2026-11-08; a case joins when it shows an effect on any model.
